posts.text:
Susan Collins: Profile in Irrelevance:

Collins knew that every word Cheney said was right. Cheney was willing to stand up; and she was willing to pay the price. But as the party descended into dishonor, Susan Collins stood by wringing her hands.
charliesykes.substack.com/p/susan-coll...
posts.summary: Criticizes Collins for failing to stand against party dishonor

posts.text:
It's more than a little ironic to hear Collins now talking about her “impact,” because it's unlikely that history will remember her at all, except as a political cipher who faded into obscurity; and whose fate was the irrelevance she so desperately feared.

charliesykes.substack.com/p/susan-coll...
